half: memory stress (the realism half is 24a / nitroba.pcap)
description: 1,450,000 small frames over 290 s across 200 concurrent TCP conversations. Per conversation the server sends a 1-byte segment (55 B frame) and the client answers with a 54-byte pure ACK whose ack number strictly advances by 1 every time. Worst case for frames-per-megabyte and flow-table churn; healthy traffic in every other respect.

groundTruth.tsharkVerification: tshark 4.6.3: `-Y tcp.analysis.flags` matches 0 frames; `-Y 'tcp.checksum.status=="Bad" || ip.checksum.status=="Bad"'` matches 0 frames.
groundTruth.phsNote: tshark protocol hierarchy attributes 721,375 frames to the `data` layer rather than 725,000 because consecutive 1-byte segments are grouped by TCP PDU reassembly. The on-wire count of payload-bearing frames is exactly 725,000.

certaintyGovernance.rule: Zero findings. This fixture is a false-positive guard at scale: the traffic is healthy, so volume alone must never be escalated into a finding.
certaintyGovernance.absentHandshake: No SYN appears (the capture starts mid-stream). The engine may note handshake absence as a capture-vantage observation at 'info' at most, and must NOT report tcp.handshake-incomplete as a network fault.
certaintyGovernance.smallFrames: A 54-byte average frame size is a property of the traffic, not a defect. No 'small packet' or 'ACK flood' finding is permitted without an accompanying loss or latency signal, and neither exists here.

performanceContract.note: 1,450,000 frames at 54.5 B average in 102.2 MB - the highest frame-count-per-byte case the engine will see. The columnar SoA store must hold this without exceeding the heap ceiling and without falling back to per-frame object allocation. A run that completes but emits any finding fails the fixture.

notes: The capture is intentionally not committed (102 MB). Regenerate with `python3 test-corpus/generate-stress.py` and verify md5 0aaa00d5e3e662a9984e599c5d376de3 before use. Reference ground truth lives in test-corpus/reference/stress/ (capinfos with SHA-256, protocol hierarchy, and a gzipped per-frame tshark CSV of the first 20,000 frames - the full 1.45M-row CSV is not committed for size reasons). A pure zero-length-ACK capture is deliberately NOT used: acknowledging data that never appears on the wire produces 'ACKed unseen segment' on every frame, which is a real finding and would contradict the zero-findings contract.
